patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: They set it yesterday and the painkillers aren't touching it. It's not the break — it's like my whole forearm is being crushed in a vice. And my fingers feel wrong.
presentation.triageNote: 22-year-old male with a forearm fracture casted eighteen hours ago, now with escalating pain far out of proportion to the injury, severe pain on passive finger extension and pins and needles.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because pain out of proportion, pain with passive stretch, paresthesias, and escalating symptoms beneath a new cast indicate a time-critical limb threat.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has classic early findings of rising forearm compartment pressure after fracture immobilization.
clinical.acuityReason: Pain out of proportion, pain with passive stretch, paresthesias, and escalating symptoms beneath a new cast indicate a time-critical limb threat.
expectedResources: Immediate cast release and surgical examination
Compartment-pressure measurement when diagnosis remains uncertain
redFlags: Pain out of proportion and passive-stretch pain
teachingPoints: Pain out of proportion plus pain on passive stretch IS compartment syndrome until proven otherwise. Pulses stay present until it is far too late — never wait for pulselessness.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate pressure relief and surgical assessment would likely lead to urgent fasciotomy when the diagnosis is confirmed.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 22-year-old man in a t-shirt with a white plaster cast on his right forearm, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting rigidly forward, cradling the casted forearm, fingers of the casted hand held stiffly splayed
signs: swollen puffy fingers protruding from the cast
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 22-year-old man in a t-shirt with a white plaster cast on his right forearm, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting rigidly forward, cradling the casted forearm, fingers of the casted hand held stiffly splayed. Expression: grey with pain, teeth clenched. Clearly visible: a white forearm cast; swollen puffy fingers protruding from the cast; sweat on a pale face. Overall: in severe distress from pain. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
